FAQ_SUBHEADLINE: Everything about rooms, check-in, and your stay.
FAQ_1_Q: What are check-in and check-out times?
FAQ_1_A: Check-in is in the afternoon and check-out is late morning. Early arrival and late departure can often be arranged, just ask.
FAQ_2_A: Plans change. Most rates offer flexible cancellation up to a day or two before arrival, with the details shown clearly at booking.
FAQ_3_A: We will point you to the easiest parking and any options nearby, and the front desk is happy to help on arrival.
FAQ_4_Q: Do you offer early check-in or luggage storage?
FAQ_4_A: Whenever we can, yes. Reach out ahead of time and we will hold your bags and ready your room as early as possible.

ABOUT_PARAGRAPH_1: We started with a simple belief: a good stay should feel effortless. Not fussy, not impersonal, just genuinely good from the moment you arrive.
ABOUT_PARAGRAPH_2: So we designed rooms that rest you, hired people who love hosting, and rooted ourselves in a neighborhood we are proud to send you into.
ABOUT_PARAGRAPH_3: The result is a place that feels less like a hotel and more like a friend's beautifully kept home, with all the comfort and none of the hassle.
ABOUT_PARAGRAPH_4: Whether it is one night or one month, our promise is the same: you will be looked after, and you will want to come back.
FAQ_BILL_1_Q: How do rates and deposits work?
FAQ_BILL_1_A: Rates are shown clearly at booking with no surprises. Any deposit or hold is stated up front before you confirm.
FAQ_BILL_2_Q: Are there resort or service fees?
FAQ_BILL_2_A: We keep pricing honest. Any applicable taxes or fees are itemized before you complete your reservation, never after.
FAQ_SUP_1_Q: How do I reach the front desk?
FAQ_SUP_1_A: Someone is available around the clock by phone or in person. For anything before arrival, our contact page has the fastest line.
FAQ_SUP_2_Q: What if I need something during my stay?
FAQ_SUP_2_A: Just ask. From extra pillows to dinner recommendations, our team is here to make your stay simpler.
